doc.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: Goodman and Krupa on the film set; the Goodman stare
summary: Goodman tries to get Krupa fired; Green says the famous Ray stare was a myth.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Well, when Benny was playing out there he decided he didn’t like the way Gene Krupa played anymore, for some reason, because he was the star of his early band, you know Gene. And he was trying to get him fired. I happened to be rooming with Gene on the set, like on the dressing rooms we shared the same dressing room. And he said, “the old man’s trying to get me fired.” But he couldn’t fire him because his contract was with the studio, not with Benny.
Did he give him “the Ray?” I keep hearing about that “Ray.”
No, that’s just a myth I think.
He just, he might be looking at you but thinking about something completely different. He was one of those kind of people.
And you think he’s trying to stare you down or something, huh?
That’s what people thought. I never took it that way. I got to know Benny pretty well.
